title: Cluster-norm vs. plain CCS: independently checking the claimed fix for unsupervised probing

original_idea.body:
# Cluster-norm vs Plain CCS

Reimplement both on fresh datasets; measure improvement and ablate clustering step.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: replicating an ELK-probing fix builds trustworthy elicitation but the step to concrete catastrophe is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reimplement CCS and cluster-norm on open model; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused replication-plus-ablation across datasets; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected independent replication of a single-paper fix, open tooling, classic external verification.

low_compute.reasoning: CCS on small model, one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Cluster-norm is recent; an independent cross-dataset replication may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Single-paper fix; independent replication may be open.
